# Tussle Furniture Co.

> Furniture concepts for small spaces in India, with interactive 3D previews.

Tussle Furniture Co. (also referred to as Lovetussle) is a furniture brand presenting furniture concepts for small spaces and interactive 3D previews.

## Verified facts

- Official website: https://www.lovetussle.com/
- Official Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/lovetussle/
- Brand: Tussle Furniture Co.
- Website/brand name also used: Lovetussle.
- Focus: furniture concepts for small rooms and interactive 3D previews.
- Contact: lovetussle@gmail.com

## Pages

- [Homepage and collection](https://www.lovetussle.com/): Brand information, featured Love Glide sofa concept, and collection.
- [Dusk sofa-bed](https://www.lovetussle.com/concepts/dusk-sofa-bed.html): Interactive furniture concept.
- [Kandariya Floor Lounger](https://www.lovetussle.com/concepts/kandariya-floor-lounger.html): Interactive floor-lounger concept.
- [Love Glide sofa](https://www.lovetussle.com/concepts/love-glide-sofa.html): Interactive sofa concept.
- [Lowlight coffee table](https://www.lovetussle.com/concepts/lowlight-coffee-table.html): Interactive coffee-table concept.
- [Hold chair](https://www.lovetussle.com/concepts/hold-chair.html): Interactive chair concept.
- [Nightshift desk](https://www.lovetussle.com/concepts/nightshift-desk.html): Interactive desk concept.
- [The 9 m² room](https://www.lovetussle.com/concepts/room-9sqm.html): Interactive room concept.

## Important context

The 3D pages are concept previews, not confirmation that a design is available to buy. Dimensions, load ratings, and other specifications shown in previews may be placeholders and are not confirmed product specifications. Ask Tussle to confirm current availability, pricing, and product details.
